prompt: Output one JSON object with numeric dx,dy (mm) and yaw (degrees): one relative translation and yaw correction to seat a two-hole cover onto both round pins, 32 mm apart. Rotate about plate center; positive yaw is counterclockwise seen from above. Fixed red dots are 88 mm apart on the target X axis; moving green dots are 60 mm apart along the plate local X axis. Pair midpoints are the target and part origins. World X points right and Y away (up in overhead view). Camera1 looks obliquely from -Y at 15 degrees from vertical. Cameras have 40 deg vertical FOV, 360 square pixels, look at (0,0,9) mm from distance 170 mm. Per-side clearance 1.0 mm. Account for different heights. Only use supplied images, no tools. Return dx,dy,yaw to one decimal place. Second image is a simultaneous overhead view of the same pose, with the same target and working distance.
